items.original: ThrIVe Drip Spa (I Thrive Drip Holdings, LLC) respects your privacy. This policy explains what we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have. By using thrivedripspa.com or our services you consent to the practices described here.

items.original: Contact details you provide (name, email, phone) when you book, join the newsletter, submit a form or text us; billing information processed by our payment providers; health information collected during your Good Faith Exam and treatment, which is protected as described in our Notice of Privacy Practices; and technical data such as IP address, browser and pages visited, collected through cookies and analytics.

items.original: We use cookies and similar tools — Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager, and our customer platform, Wellgentic — to understand how people use this site and to measure our advertising. They are on by default. If you later book or contact us, we may link your earlier visits to your record so we know which marketing brought you to us.

items.original: Your health information is protected. You have the right to see and get a copy of your records, ask us to correct them, request confidential communications, ask us to limit what we share, get a list of those we've shared information with, and get a copy of this notice. We use and share health information to treat you, run our organization, bill for services, and as required by law. We will never use your health information for marketing or sell it without your written permission. We are required by law to maintain the privacy and security of your protected health information and to notify you promptly if a breach occurs.
